title: “Pride builds thrones… but truth only needs a whisper to bring them down.”
paragraphs:
“Pride builds thrones… but truth only needs a whisper to bring them down.”
When God exposes what we built on ego, He replaces it with what can stand on grace.
This is the moment pride falls… and truth rises. ✨
“Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.” — Proverbs 16:18
